svg.text: Full-Stack Web Developer (MERN Stack) | Karachi, Pakistan
I'm Muhammad Muzammil, a Full-Stack Web Developer and BSCS student
at KIET, Karachi, Pakistan, working across the MERN stack (MongoDB,
Express.js, React.js, Node.js) and WordPress. I build web apps end to end —
from Supabase/MongoDB-backed backends to React and vanilla-JS frontends.
Full Stack Developer Intern @ NexSoft Solutions
Previously: WordPress Blog Developer @ Webera Solution
